description: Execute EVERY workflow (or a scoped subset) for a sandbox in ONE call. Use this — NOT a loop of run_workflow — for any validation-style request: "validate this integration", "run all workflows", "check coverage", "test stripe checkout", "fs validate". IDEs (Cursor, Claude Code) approve each MCP call individually, so 18 workflows via run_workflow = 18 clicks. This tool = 1 click, total. Scope via `workflow_names`: pass an array of workflow ids to run a subset (e.g., user says "validate stripe CHECKOUT" → pass ["create_checkout_session", "checkout_complete"]). Names are case-insensitive; dashes and underscores interchangeable. Returns: summary (pass/fail counts, totals) + full step trace per workflow. After running, the user can visit fetchsandbox.com/runs/<sandbox_id> for a shareable visual timeline.

workflow_names.description: Optional list of workflow ids/names to run. Case-insensitive; dashes and underscores are interchangeable. Omit to run every workflow for the spec.

name: run_all_workflows
